title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8-EN · V2 CO5300 + CST820
summary: 1.8英寸368×448、16MiB Flash/8MiB PSRAM；官方V1 SH8601/FT3168与2026-05-30起V2 CO5300/CST820分开。TCA/AXP/ES8311、真实单线TF与高有效SYS_OUT电源键；电池/无电池SKU分列。

facts.label: 主控存储容量
facts.notes: 容量属于此SKU/已注明硬件版本；不从通用ESP32名称推断。

facts.label: 本次实现的源代码接线

value.power: DCDC1 VCC3V3 powers display/touch/SD/QMI/ES8311 digital; RTCbackup independent; otherALDO testpad outputs are not fabricated display rails

facts.label: 官方原版镜像调查
facts.notes: 固定Git commit的官方README与BSP依赖分别确认V1组件1.1.4、V2组件2.0.3；原厂两完整BIN严格定向对应版本。V1真实ROM5秒201帧/1304色进入Brookesia早期UI；V2真实运行337guest ms发现CST@15后因未知ID读取NACK触发ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE/abort/reset，0帧。保留失败原UART和黑帧，不假ID或修改原BIN。

facts.label: 已抓取UIFlow与小智发布目录
facts.notes: 小智列表由100+100+0分页与latest资产ID交叉核对为完整200项。精确名称仅建立候选分发身份，未下载/审计的资产不冒运行兼容。UIFlow当前58项与较旧landing选择器的范围化无Waveshare结果，不证明不存在第三方移植。

unknowns.notes: 原V2程序在读取CST820身份时abort；该未知寄存器保持NACK，未借用CST816S/D身份。数字触点坐标可单独测，不能声称V2原厂UI已通过。；V1实际早期彩色画面仍不等于完整界面/音频/联网/物理触摸通过；所有条目simulationVerified=false。；AXP使用明确理想USB/no-cell、datasheet参考启动子集；变体DC5/充电、watchdog、长按关机/CPU供电及模拟音频不假ACK。；可用STEP为裸参考板，不确认当前V2内部改版；按官方37.6×45.2×15mm外尺寸建有孔空心壳，半径/壁厚明示估计。电池尺寸/标签/安装、内部机械装配和精确侧孔UNKNOWN。；本型号尚未完成实物验证。目录、数字外设测试、原厂固件原生执行和浏览器worker验收是不同证据层；逐项范围见知识页。；商品页顺序用作带屏优先的工作队列，不能据此认定发布日期。

collectionNotes: V1/V2独立显示die、gap0/gap16与触摸地址38h/15h，实际GRAM红像素、错误quad线拒绝。
真实TCA P0/P2独立复位、P1 DSI不误关屏、P4高有效key、P7 TF native门控；DCDC1掉电重置TCA/QMI/codec并撤回触控ACK。
原厂两个完整ROM分别有界运行，V1彩色UI与V2未知CST身份失败都保留；7份本组原厂STEP中包含1.8裸参考板。
Exact storefront SKU registration with the stated digital subsets. Partial does not mean whole-device or physical acceptance.
精确SKU包内电池、外壳、排针和天线差异保持独立身份；共用数字路径不表示机械与RF等价。

UIFlow/小智是固定Git板树的范围化调查，生成检查收据不冒称HTTP响应：{"uiflow": "固定提交a61a29409f09f1f4bebae05e15c4bd6dcc4956b6板树中无Waveshare命名目录；此检索范围不证明不存在第三方移植。", "xiaozhi": "固定提交92d400d6374bbe750e0a0188fa969fc4042820c2板树已检索；未建立此精确SKU的可直接运行镜像。"}

模型逐项边界：Native manufacturer source shapes are preserved at unit scale, including original mechanical standoffs and headers; simplified colors do not identify IC packages or establish measured optical appearance.；Mechanical source revision, fitted connector mating, touch accuracy and physical display coordinate calibration remain unvalidated.；Original exterior dimensions constrain this hollow reference.1mm wall and1mm front/back caps are declared estimates, not measured internalCAD. Exact fasteners, ribs, connector pockets and fit remain UNKNOWN; optical aperture is a real through-hole.；The native STEP is the bare reference assembly; the product includes a case. Native electronics remain unscaled inside the dimension-constrained hollow enclosure.7mm body and5.7mm optical corner radii are approximate photo-derived visualization parameters, not manufacturer measurements.；V1 SH8601/FT3168 and V2 CO5300/CST820 share documented outside dimensions, but current V2 internal source-CAD correspondence is UNKNOWN. Original V1 rear branding is retained only as a reference photo and is not mapped as V2 branding.；Case key caps, USB/TF/speaker apertures, battery installation and internal ribs remain UNKNOWN; public2D BOOT/POWER controls expose real digital inputs without invented3D key geometry.；SKU29958-EN excludes the optional3.7V MX1.25 battery; common native board and outside case remain identical in the documented source.
